issue.title: Slash Go To — open any open task in Obsidian from Bob Mac Capture
issue.description: Typing `/` as the whole capture draft opens a Go To picker over exactly the `:` task catalog; picking a row hides the panel, clears the draft, and lands Obsidian's caret on that task in its home area/project/inbox note (centred, with a `<C-o>` jump) without writing anything to the vault.

payload.entry: CI: SHA 6345673d2dbe8a0daacd37b664fe366370bc3b25 (feat(capture): open Obsidian from the Go To picker). Run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/38417330907 failed at Lint Swift formatting after 26s; Build/Test skipped. gh run view --log-failed grepped for error: shows 42 errors, all in CaptureLinkGuardPresentation.swift (14), CaptureModelTests.swift (22), and CaptureTogglePresentationTests.swift (6). The same 42 error lines appear on parent a86eddb (run 38414162582) and 8f89423 (run 38408350959). This phase's files have zero error: lines. Last green master CI is eed300d (run 38140692096).

Mac acceptance pass (Bryan, after the epic) — copy of plan:202610/slash_task_goto.md § Mac acceptance pass:

- Cold start. Check Obsidian both quit and running.
  - If the URI is dropped when the URI itself launches Obsidian, file a follow-up for the app: launch md.obsidian, wait for it to finish launching plus a short settle, then dispatch.
  - Never add a plain open?path= "insurance" URI. It replaces the active tab and defeats leaf reuse.
- Landing.
  - the note already open in a split;
  - the task under a folded heading or list;
  - a Reading-view leaf;
  - the caret on the row in Vim normal mode, and <C-o> returning;
  - Unicode and spaces in paths.
- Moved lines.
  - Edit above the task between the search and the accept: it lands correctly with no Notice.
  - Edit the task line itself: the Notice appears.
- Lifecycle.
  - Escape during the fetch, a double Return, a dispatch failure, and a reopened panel never launch Obsidian late or capture anything.
  - A canceled / draft never comes back from the stash.
- No writes. Accept one identified row and one ID-less row. The note and day files stay byte-identical (git -C ~/bob status is clean).

Rollout first: from bob-cli, just install-all (or bob plugins sync -p bob-navigation-hotkeys, then install bob and the app). Before the panel, test the handler from Terminal with open 'obsidian://bob-goto-task?…' using target/line/ref from bob capture-complete -c 1 -f json -- '/'.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Repair existing bob-mac-capture Swift CI lint/compile failures — identical 42 swift-format error: lines on this SHA 6345673 (run 38417330907), parent a86eddb (run 38414162582), and 8f89423 (run 38408350959): CaptureLinkGuardPresentation.swift reserved `guard` identifier, CaptureTogglePresentationTests.swift malformed multiline literals, CaptureModelTests.swift reserved `guard` local. Already proposed on bob-cli-7d.3 note #1; no task bead tracks it yet. This phase added no new error: lines; Build/Test never ran.

mac-goto-panel landed on bob-mac-capture master 6345673d2dbe8a0daacd37b664fe366370bc3b25 (feat(capture): open Obsidian from the Go To picker). task_goto needs/completions route into the Go To picker; acceptTaskGotoRow uses injectable taskGotoOpener, in-flight lock, discard+dismiss on success, picker stays on failure; Ctrl-C discards a / draft (never CanceledDraftStash); ID-less rows open directly; Shift/Option-↩ consumed; README Go To Picker + requirements; CaptureTaskGotoPanelTests plus fake-bob / and /dee parse/complete fixtures. Fake-bob / and /dee verified locally. memory_goto_record=no; no memory notes edited. CI https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/38417330907 red at Lint with the same 42 error: lines as a86eddb and 8f89423 (bob-cli-7d.3 note #1); this phase added none; Build/Test skipped. Mac acceptance checklist copied onto this bead. No leftover --epic-symbol entries.

Verified bob-cli-7d. Phases 7d.1–7d.4 are closed done. memory_goto_record=no was honored: no decisions:task-goto-never-writes strand and no other memory edit.

cli-goto (f2f2fd0): task_goto_query_token claims a whole-draft single-/ token; item.rs refuses it with the T3 error before the & scan; completion, capture-complete, and the shell arm exist; TaskGotoCandidate uses discover+rank with note_path, target, empty replacement, and no requires_block_id, block_id_suggestions, or pulls_forward; line_digest vectors are asserted from tests/fixtures/line_digest/vectors.json; docs/capture.md has the Go To section.

plugin-goto-uri (76924cc, bob-navigation-hotkeys 2.32.0, still the plugin tip, parent 4f0cc94): onload registers obsidian://bob-goto-task behind the function guard; the handler validates, maps the vault path with one realpath retry, re-finds planned then block then unique digest then clamped, notices only when a ref clamps, and lands through focusTaskAnchor, which re-resolves the anchor on the live editor. The digest strip is the Rust trim_end set, not trimEnd.

mac-goto-core/panel (a86eddb, 6345673): taskGotoURL keeps slashes and encodes + as %2B; goto-mode rows open directly with no Add block ID; acceptTaskGotoRow locks, opens through taskGotoOpener, discards and dismisses on success, and keeps the picker on failure; Ctrl-C discards a / draft instead of stashing it. README Go To Picker requires hotkeys ≥ 2.32.0. 7d.4 note #2 is Bryan's post-epic Mac acceptance checklist, copied as the plan required.

Integration since f2f2fd0 needs no Go To edit. bob-cli bdfc8c3, 2d1adfa, and c80cbde do not touch task_goto sources; the / row and Go To section in docs/capture.md remain. Go To never reaches the link guard. bob-plugins has no later commit. bob-mac-capture 7b87f79 (bob-cli-7b) sits on 6345673 and only renames guard / rewrites toggle fixtures. handleTaskLinkCompletion is parameterized by source and does not write on task_goto.

Filed ready task bob-cli-7f (ci, small), related to bob-cli-7b and bob-cli-73. No in-progress epic owns it.
